scripts.ensure-env: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('Created .env from .env.example — fill in your keys (see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md §4).');}"
scripts.setup: npm run ensure-env && prisma generate && prisma db push
scripts.setup:production: node scripts/check-datasource.mjs && prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.production.prisma && prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.production.prisma --skip-generate
scripts.docker-start: npm run setup:production && npm run start
